title: Mold Remediation Sample Collection by the Water Crew: Collection Credit
content:
When a company Water Damage Mitigation crew is already on site, it collects the pre-removal asbestos samples for the Mold Remediation job and the sampling line takes a collection credit.

**Rule.** The water crew's presence is judged on the mold job's opened date, when the samples are collected. When the linked water job's drying start date is on or before that opened date and it has no drying complete date on or before it, the drying crew collects the samples on a monitoring visit and the full collection credit of 75.00 is subtracted. When the linked water job was opened on or before the mold job's opened date but has neither a drying start date nor a cancelled date on or before it, the mobilising crew collects them and the partial collection credit of 40.00 is subtracted. With no linked water job, or a water job whose drying ended or which was cancelled on or before the opened date, or one opened after it, no collection credit applies.

## Reading the linked water job on the mold job's opened date

| Linked water job, as of the mold job's opened date | Credit subtracted |
|---|---|
| Drying started on or before that date; no drying complete date on or before it | 75.00 full collection credit |
| Opened on or before that date; no drying start date and no cancelled date on or before it | 40.00 partial collection credit |
| Drying complete date on or before that date | None |
| Cancelled on or before that date | None |
| Opened after that date | None |
| No linked water job | None |

Hypothetical: a water job opened on 3 October with drying started on 4 October. A mold job opened on 4 October takes 75.00; one opened on 3 October takes 40.00. If that water job's drying completed on 9 October, a mold job opened on 9 October takes no credit.
